name: Old Canberra Brickworks (Yarralumla Brickworks)
area: Yarralumla — Section 102, Block 1; public-road vicinity via Denman Street
status: Disused historic industrial site — access not confirmed; permission required
notes: Historic brickworks established in 1913, production began in 1916 and ceased in 1976. ACT heritage-listed. An ACT Government transport report describes the site as not in operation and notes access was provided off Denman Street; this is not permission to enter and the site may be redeveloped or restricted. View only from public roads unless the land manager confirms lawful public access. No precise pin supplied because visitor access is not confirmed. Checked 12 Nov 2026. Sources: https://www.act.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0009/1945872/canberra-brickworks-precinct-conservation-management-plan-2021-volume-1.pdf ; https://www.legislation.act.gov.au/DownloadFile/di/2021-195/current/PDF/2021-195.PDF ; https://dafinder.blob.core.windows.net/dadocuments/DOCs/TRAFFICREPORT-202342069-01.pdf

name: Rock Valley Homestead Ruins
area: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve — public entry via Tidbinbilla Visitor Centre, Tidbinbilla Reserve Road, Paddys River ACT 2620. Follow signed visitor routes; the homestead is reached within the reserve.
status: Historic homestead ruins — public reserve access; check entry conditions
notes: Restored remains of a pioneer homestead built in 1895. The homestead precinct is inside Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve; use the official reserve entrance and visitor information rather than attempting off-track access. Entry fees and reserve closures may apply. Keep to signed paths and do not disturb the ruins. Sources: https://www.tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/learn/early-pioneer-heritage ; https://www.tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/visit/getting-here ; https://www.tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/visit

name: Nil Desperandum Homestead
area: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve — public entry via Tidbinbilla Visitor Centre, Tidbinbilla Reserve Road, Paddys River ACT 2620. Access is by walking tracks within the reserve.
status: Historic homestead — walking-track access; check reserve conditions
notes: Historic rural homestead in Tidbinbilla Valley, accessible via walking tracks within Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve. This is a heritage place, not an abandoned building to enter freely; follow park directions and respect any booking or access restrictions. Entry fees and closures may apply. Sources: https://www.tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/learn/early-pioneer-heritage ; https://www.tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/visit/getting-here

name: Orroral Homestead
area: Orroral Campground, Orroral Road, Namadgi National Park ACT 2620 — start of the signed Orroral Heritage walking track.
status: Historic homestead remains — official walking track listed open; check alerts
notes: Historic homestead in Orroral Valley, reached via the Orroral Heritage walking track from Orroral Campground. Parks ACT lists the track as open, but conditions can change. Campground bookings are required; stay on the marked route and check park alerts before travelling. Sources: https://www.parks.act.gov.au/find-a-nature-park/namadgi-national-park/namadgi-national-park-walking-tracks ; https://www.parks.act.gov.au/find-a-nature-park/namadgi-national-park/orroral-campground

name: Horse Gully Hut / John Lennane's Hut Site
area: Mount Clear Campground, Naas Valley Fire Trail, Namadgi National Park ACT 2620 — public walking access starts at the campground.
status: Historic hut and earlier hut remains — walking access; check track conditions
notes: The current hut was built during World War II; a few hearthstones remain from the earlier John Lennane's Hut. Parks ACT directs walkers to start from Mount Clear Campground and follow the Naas Valley Fire Trail. Remote walking route: prepare appropriately, check alerts and do not disturb historic remains. Sources: https://www.parks.act.gov.au/things-to-do/historic-huts ; https://www.act.gov.au/our-canberra/latest-news/2026/september/top-camping-spots-close-to-canberra

name: Brayshaws and Westermans Homesteads
area: Settlers Track, southern Namadgi National Park ACT 2620 — use the signed public walking track and official trailhead information from Parks ACT.
status: Historic homestead remains — signed walking-track access; check conditions
notes: Historic pastoral homestead sites in southern Namadgi National Park. Parks ACT identifies the sites along Settlers Track; this is a bushwalking destination, not a road-side address. Follow the official track, check current access and fire/road alerts, and leave all structures and artefacts undisturbed. Sources: https://www.parks.act.gov.au/things-to-do/historic-huts ; https://www.namadginationalpark.com.au/trails/settlers-track/

name: Brandy Flat Hut
area: Brandy Flat Fire Trail, Namadgi National Park ACT 2620 — access from Boboyan Road (south) or Glendale Crossing (north).
status: Historic hut — public walking/cycling access; check fire-trail conditions
notes: The original hut dates from the early 1900s; the current hut was built nearby in the 1980s and is used by walkers and cyclists. Parks ACT describes access via Brandy Flat Fire Trail from Boboyan Road or Glendale Crossing. This is a remote park location, not an abandoned building; follow the Huts Code for Visitors and check conditions before setting out. Source: https://www.parks.act.gov.au/things-to-do/historic-huts
